body:
**RAV-RUN2-R1-F003 [medium] cli** — The module entry point builds the old argument namespace

The changed handler reads missing fields and fails before conversion.

Please use the shared top-level parser in the module entry point. Please add one offline entry-point test.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F011 [medium] registry-identity** — Normalized organization collisions can rewrite an exact canonical ID to another canonical organization.

Please make exact canonical IDs win first. Please resolve normalized spellings only when one organization owns them.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F002 [medium] documentation** — The smoke command passes a directory to a file-only validator

Its output root also cannot satisfy datastore path checks.

Please use the required `data/<collection>` path for smoke output. Please pass a quoted fixed-depth file glob to the validator.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F004 [medium] data-validation** — Missing scores become incorrect answers and stay in aggregate denominators

Missing token data becomes measured zero instead of being omitted.

Please add rows with invalid scores to the failure report. Please omit incomplete token usage. Please base token means only on complete values.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F002 [medium] repository-integration** — The adapter remains under the retired `utils` layout

Installed packages include `every_eval_ever*`, so this adapter and its documented command are outside the active package.

Please integrate current main before the move. Please then move the adapter and references under `every_eval_ever/adapters/open_medical_llm`. Please use the imported schema version in tests.

**RAV-RUN2-R1-F004 [medium] metric-identity** — Ordinary accuracy receives nine benchmark-specific metric IDs

This fragments the global accuracy join key.

Please keep `accuracy` as the metric ID. Please preserve benchmark identity in task-specific evaluation names.
